title: Scaffold iOS module and integrate into lib.rs
brief: Create ios.rs with IosPlatform and IosDevice structs implementing Platform and Device traits (stub methods returning unimplemented!). Add ios module to lib.rs. Add ios::run function that returns None (placeholder). Extend COMMANDS with ("ios", ios::run).

title: Implement idb helpers and UDID resolution
brief: Add idb() function similar to ios_visual.rs. Add resolve_udid() that returns a UDID string (--device argument or first booted simulator via idb list-targets). Store UDID in IosDevice.

title: Implement AX tree reading and element lookup
brief: Implement get_element, count_matches, hierarchy using idb ui describe-all --json. Parse JSON into accessibility nodes. Compute element bounds, clip to screen viewport. Return Element with bounds, full, text, frame.

title: Implement tap, swipe, input_text, press_key
brief: Implement tap_at via idb ui tap. Implement swipe via idb ui drag or swipe. Implement input_text via idb ui text. Implement press_key for Enter, Backspace, Tab, arrows, Ctrl+End via idb ui key.

title: Implement screenshot, keyboard detection, device state
brief: Implement take_screenshot via idb screenshot -. Implement keyboard_visible by scanning AX tree for keyboard node. Implement get_device_state returning screen bounds and keyboard visibility.

title: Implement video recording start/stop with SIGINT
brief: Implement start_recording using idb video record --udid <UDID> <path>, store child process pid. Implement stop_recording sending SIGINT to child, waiting, returning recorded file paths.

title: Implement draw_strokes_on for Tamil glyph gestures
brief: Implement draw_strokes_on that reads source stroke commands (format TBD), maps to element bounds, calls idb ui scribble with stroke points. Return JSON with strokes count.

title: Add iOS flow test stub
brief: Create minimal flow test that uses stubbed idb command (like goldens test). Test that ios driver can be instantiated and a trivial command works. Gate runs flow test with stubs.
